name: 개인 홈페이지
description: Initial experimental family contract for same-family template switching.

navigation.identity: stable item id; labels and paths may be edited
navigation.path_policy: one leading slash; no external/protocol-relative URL, query, fragment, backslash, or dot segment

media.validated_format: SVG fixture only; production format/size policy pending

content_types.identity: stable lowercase ASCII kebab-case filename stem
content_types.frontmatter_policy: optional; missing content type and identity are inferred from the source path; unknown properties are preserved and ignored by the template

content_types.identity: stable lowercase ASCII kebab-case directory slug

title.description: Optional display title; templates fall back to the first Markdown H1 and then the path-derived slug.

published_at.description: Actual publication instant; BlogGenius writes this at the publication action.

editorial_status.description: Authoring completeness only; independent of publication.

publication.description: Deployment and listing intent: none stays local; private deploys an unlisted detail page; public deploys and lists the post.

author.description: Optional creator name; templates expose it as author metadata when present.

cover.description: Optional representative image relative to the post entry, typically ./images/<file>. BlogGenius selects the first embedded image automatically.

cover_alt.description: Alternative text for the representative image, usually copied from the image block title.

content_types.frontmatter_policy: optional; missing content type and identity are inferred from the source path; unknown properties are preserved and ignored by the template

content_types.identity: stable lowercase ASCII kebab-case directory slug
content_types.frontmatter_policy: optional; missing content type and identity are inferred from the source path; unknown properties are preserved and ignored by the template

content_frontmatter_policy.post_author: optional string; omitted unless explicitly supplied
content_frontmatter_policy.post_representative_image: optional cover entry-relative path; BlogGenius chooses the first embedded image; templates use it for thumbnails and social preview metadata
